title: Fine Print
summary: Start: enter Fine Print. The log opens the job and the helm marks the school buoy. Do: enter the ambush sight, 520 meters of the school buoy. The ambush holds until a keel crosses that line. A kite keeps 340 to 460 meters. The Expired Clerk runs when the pack closes inside 640 meters, and a raider takes that clerk. Finish: after the sight is sprung, come inside Expired Charter's shell. The Charter writes standing. Wreck rights stay red. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
